text: The DP02 branch of the record read answers one contact row per contact point of the case's persons with contactKey, contactType, consentStatus, consentAt, verifiedAt and extensionPresent, and consentStatus is resolved as GIVEN for consent_given true, WITHDRAWN for consent_given false with a consent_at, and UNKNOWN for no extension row or no consent_at.
why: The legacy loop read the contact point in process and only the boolean DF-EXT-015 is in the dictionary; no source fixes the members of the row the loop consumes or the three-value vocabulary, so the answer cannot be published without a ruling.
read: TSD P1 v3 T-A.2 API-P1-010 (DataProductRecordPage for a case, with the product's freshness stamp); TSD P1 T3.5 contact_point_ext; LDM v8 DF-EXT-013 to DF-EXT-019; legacy RWB-E2-021 AC5 (WITHDRAWN) and section 11; FSD P1 A2.2 DP02 (Customer and party, v_ace_contact and contact_point_ext, DAILY, 08:00).
confirm: Solution architect, P1 with the data steward
impact: If the row or the vocabulary changes, the OpenAPI fragment of 12.1, the DP02 handler and AC1 change; no table, grant or migration is affected.

text: The interaction ledger of rwb-source-data is published as POST /cases/{caseId}/interactions and GET /cases/{caseId}/interactions, and the /interactions family of RWB-P1-E1066-APP and RWB-P6-E2021-CON is realigned to them.
why: The Ownership Map is the authority for the service's provided operations and lists the case-scoped form, while the writer story and the loop contract already publish a flat form; one of the two must win and the case-scoped form carries the case check and the scope in the address.
read: Ownership Map v1 P1 rows; RWB-P1-E1066-APP and RWB-P1-E1066-CON section 12.1; RWB-P6-E2021-CON sections 12.2 and 12.8; RWB-P3-E2021-APP fragment ops_consumed; Template and Rules v1 section R5.5 DP-13 and DP-18.
confirm: Solution architect, P1 with the P6 squad
impact: Three published artefacts move with this ruling (the writer contract, the loop fake and the case consumer); the story's own code is unaffected because it publishes the fragment of 12.1.

text: Every LETTER entry carries a conductCheck, an externalRef is required whenever a deliveryStatus is stated and refused when it is not, a BLOCKED entry carries neither a deliveryStatus nor an externalRef, and an externalRef longer than 60 characters is refused with 422 instead of truncated.
why: The legacy entry recorded conduct check and barcode in one mutable row and no source states which members of the split append are mandatory, while the column lengths of the dictionary fix the refusal at the boundary.
read: LDM v8 DF-INT-012 conduct_check (LOV-CONDUCT), DF-INT-028 delivery_status (LOV-SEND-STATUS), DF-INT-029 external_ref varchar(60); legacy RWB-E2-021 AC1, AC4, AC5, section 11; RWB-P1-E1066-CON section 12.1 (422 MSG-GEN-001 for a missing required value).
confirm: Solution architect, P1 with the comms squad
impact: A refused append writes nothing, so the loop holds the notice; if the ruling changes, the validator and AC6 change and the ledger stays as it is.

text: The notice type and the hold reason travel as text of the interaction summary, because interaction has no notice_type or hold_reason column and this story adds no column.
why: The legacy entry named the notice type and the hold reason against the notice and the decision log, both of which are other services' in the target, while the summary is the only free-text member of the ledger entry.
read: LDM v8 DF-INT-011 summary varchar(2000); legacy RWB-E2-021 AC1 (summary naming the barcode), AC4 (hold reason CONTACT_STOP_X1), section 11; Physical Schema v6 interaction columns.
confirm: Data architect with the comms squad
impact: A search by notice type on the ledger would need a column later; the entry, the fold and the read stay correct as they are.

text: The proof entry of a barcode is written by RWB-P1-E1055-APP from the v_ace_pod rows through the same ledger writer, and this story only reads it and folds it; the fold takes the latest occurred_at of a barcode with no time window.
why: The legacy loop both read the proof and updated the entry it had written; the target ledger is append only, so the proof must be a second row, and the P1 proof-of-delivery story already records the delivery entries of a case.
read: RWB-P1-E1055-APP section 12.1 (GET /proof-of-delivery?businessDate= reads v_ace_pod and records the delivery entries through the ledger writer); TSD P1 T5.1 INT-15 WIN to v_ace_pod; legacy RWB-E2-021 AC2, AC3 and section 12; BR4 of RWB-P1-E1066-APP (append only).
confirm: Solution architect, P1 with the P6 squad
impact: If the proof entry is written elsewhere, the fold still answers the latest status; only the sibling reference and the fake of 12.8 change.

text: An unserved letter is recorded with deliveryStatus FAILED of LOV-SEND-STATUS and the ACE proof result code (UNDELIVERABLE, REFUSED or PENDING) in source_ref; no value is added to the list by this story.
why: The legacy story records Unserved with the delivery status UNDELIVERABLE or PENDING and the target list carries SENT, DELIVERED, READ and FAILED only, so either the list grows or the outcome is expressed with the values in force.
read: LDM v8 LOV-SEND-STATUS (SENT, DELIVERED, READ, FAILED), DF-INT-028, DF-INT-017 source_ref (the interface or event that produced the row); legacy RWB-E2-021 AC3 and AC6; parts of the reference-data contract of DP-07 (C RWB-P3-E1043-CON).
confirm: Business lead with the data steward
impact: A conduct review that reads FAILED alone loses the distinction between refused, undeliverable and no proof unless it reads source_ref; adding UNSERVED later is a reference-data version and no code change.

text: The reference lists this story validates against (LOV-LEDGER-EVENT, LOV-CONDUCT, LOV-SEND-STATUS and the contact types) are read through the reference-data client library of DP-07 with a fixture until the reference-data contract is published.
why: The Work Package lists RWB-P6-E2021-CON as the only contract dependency and names no reference-data contract, while the values must not be constants in the code.
read: Template and Rules v1 section R5.5 DP-07; LDM v8 LOV-LEDGER-EVENT, LOV-CONDUCT, LOV-SEND-STATUS; TSD P1 T-A.2 (no reference endpoint of its own); RWB-P3-E1043-CON as the ruling of DP-07.
impact: No build dependency and no blocking call; when the contract lands, the fixture is dropped and the lists are read with their version.
